finding.title: Close the leaked DeviceRegistryDatabase in signup_screen_test.dart's createTestWidgetWithDatabase helper
finding.why: createTestWidgetWithDatabase creates a fresh in-memory DeviceRegistryDatabase on every call (3 call sites: lines 205, 247, 395) but never closes it, unlike the sibling UserDatabase two lines away that IS correctly torn down via addTearDown. Each leaked Drift NativeDatabase leaves a dangling native sqlite3 resource for the life of the test process; the file's own driftRuntimeOptions.dontWarnAboutMultipleDatabases = true suppresses the warning class of symptom this would otherwise surface.
finding.recommendation: Add addTearDown(() async => testRegistry.close()); immediately after constructing testRegistry inside createTestWidgetWithDatabase.
acceptance_criteria: every DeviceRegistryDatabase created in signup_screen_test.dart is closed via addTearDown

finding.title: Relocate test/features/parent_mode/** to mirror lib/features/profiles and lib/features/dashboard (AG-5 orphan test tree)
finding.why: lib/features/parent_mode/ does not exist and never has — the PIN service, PIN flow controller/screen, and parent dashboard aggregator were built directly under features/profiles and features/dashboard. All 9 non-duplicate test files here import from those real locations but live under a phantom 'parent_mode' test-feature directory. A contributor fixing PinService greps test/features/profiles/ for existing coverage, finds nothing, and re-adds it from scratch — this is the demonstrated direct cause of the pin_service and parent_dashboard_aggregator test-duplication findings below.
finding.recommendation: git mv pin_service_test.dart, pin_service_extended_test.dart, pin_service_profile_test.dart, presentation/providers/pin_flow_controller_test.dart, presentation/screens/pin_setup_screen_test.dart (renamed to pin_flow_screen_test.dart) into test/features/profiles/...; move domain/services/parent_dashboard_aggregator_*.dart into test/features/dashboard/domain/services/. Remove the now-empty parent_mode directory and its .gitkeep.
acceptance_criteria: Every relocated test file's import path matches its new test-tree path 1:1 with the lib/ file it targets (AG-5).
git history/blame preserved via git mv for each relocated file.

finding.title: Delete stale, narrower duplicate test/features/parent_mode/child_mode_guard_test.dart
finding.why: This file tests the same ChildModeGuard class as the properly-located test/core/navigation/child_mode_guard_test.dart but with only 4 of that file's 9 tests: it never exercises the tutored-session talmid-mirror resolution (TUT-02/TUT-06, which controls whether a tutor gets parent-management access to a talmid) or the fail-closed exception-handling regression guard, and it seeds timestamps with wall-clock DateTime.now().toUtc() (TQ-6) instead of the DateTimeFactory used consistently elsewhere. Anyone editing ChildModeGuard who runs only this stale copy gets false confidence that tutoring and fail-closed behavior are still covered.
finding.recommendation: Delete test/features/parent_mode/child_mode_guard_test.dart. test/core/navigation/child_mode_guard_test.dart already supersedes it with full coverage.

finding.title: Deduplicate PinService coverage and mock boilerplate across pin_service_extended_test.dart and pin_service_profile_test.dart

evidence.quote: class MockFlutterSecureStorage extends Mock implements FlutterSecureStorage {}
class MockFlutterSecureStorage extends Mock implements FlutterSecureStorage {}

finding.why: pin_service_extended_test.dart and pin_service_profile_test.dart independently re-test setProfilePin/verifyProfilePin/hasProfilePin/clearProfilePin, profile-scoped lockout (5-failure trigger, reset-on-success, getProfileLockoutRemainingMinutes), and the equivalent tutor-PIN surface — same scenarios, different profileId constants and wording, roughly 90% overlap. All three pin_service test files also copy-paste an identical ~35-line MockFlutterSecureStorage/createMockStorage fake instead of sharing one. If PinService's lockout-duration formula regresses, which copy a reviewer happens to update determines whether CI catches it; every change to the fake's stubbing has to be repeated three times or it silently drifts.
finding.recommendation: Merge pin_service_extended_test.dart and pin_service_profile_test.dart into one file, keeping the union of scenarios. Extract MockFlutterSecureStorage/createMockStorage into a shared test/helpers/fake_secure_storage.dart used by all PinService tests.
acceptance_criteria: Only one PinService profile/tutor-PIN extended-coverage file remains, with zero scenario loss versus the union of both originals.

evidence.quote: test('includes recent completions from last 7 days', () async {

finding.why: Both files independently seed a track+completion and assert the same compute() outputs (zero-state, points sum, 7-day recency cutoff) with different fixture-setup idioms and literal point values, and both carry a computeCompletionPercentage test with the exact same name and assertion ('returns 0.0 when no completions'). A change to the 7-day window boundary has to be re-verified in two places with different fixture styles, and neither file signals that the other asserts the same contract.
finding.recommendation: Merge parent_dashboard_aggregator_compute_test.dart into parent_dashboard_aggregator_extended_test.dart (keep the union of scenarios); drop the exact-duplicate 'no completions -> 0.0' case. Leave migration_test.dart separate — it covers a genuinely distinct tier-filter scenario set.
